rows.commentary: 1.6: Muzahir Raza strikes as Alindile Mhletywa lofts it straight into the waiting hands of Aamir Kaleem.
2.1: Shafiq Jan drops it in and Abdullah Bayoumy nudges it toward long-on for a single.
2.2: Shafiq Jan traps Gqamane right in front, and the umpire has no hesitation raising the finger for lbw.
2.3: Shafiq Jan overpitches, and Abdullah Bayoumy drills it fiercely away to the long-off boundary.
2.4: Shafiq Jan slides one through, collected cleanly by the sweeper cover as Abdullah Bayoumy scampers back for two.
2.5: Shafiq Jan serves up width and Abdullah Bayoumy launches it soaring all the way to the long-on ropes.
2.6: Shafiq Jan keeps it tight, worked smoothly into the mid-wicket pocket for a sharp single by Abdullah Bayoumy.
3.1: Usman Ali Afridi offers a gentle first-ball offering that Abdullah Bayoumy pushes easily down to long-off.
3.2: Usman Ali Afridi strays too straight and Abdullah Bayoumy sweeps it majestically into the deep mid-wicket turf for four.
3.3: Usman Ali Afridi pitches it up, allowing Abdullah Bayoumy to thump it cleanly down the ground to long-on.
3.4: Usman Ali Afridi gets greeted with maximum disdain as Abdullah Bayoumy deposits him over the long-on boundary.
3.5: Usman Ali Afridi attempts a recovery, but Abdullah Bayoumy sends it soaring majestically straight over long-off for another six.
3.6: Usman Ali Afridi strikes decisively as Abdullah Bayoumy holes out to Muzahir Raza, ending a blistering 35-run cameo off just 13 balls.
